description: Replace a shallow dict merge with a recursive deep merge where nested dicts merge but lists and scalars are replaced wholesale
prompts: merge.py's merge(base, override) does `{**base, **override}` - a shallow merge, so an override for a nested dict wipes out every sibling key the base had at that level. Implement deep_merge(base, override): for any key present in both where BOTH values are dicts, merge them recursively (same rule at every depth); for every other key, the value from `override` wins outright and REPLACES whatever was in `base` - in particular, lists are never concatenated or merged element-wise, an override list fully replaces a base list. Keys present only in `base` must survive unchanged in the result.
name: add_python_json_deep_merge
